description: Na₅Zr₂F₁₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.59 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.64 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are four shorter (2.37 Å) and four longer (2.54 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Zr is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Zr-F bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.19 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Zr atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Zr atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Zr atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one Zr atom.
